The '''Unknown Pawn Shop''' was a pawn shop located on [[Phyrstal Island]] near [[Njinska's Tavern]]. It was run by [[Vikas Sleer]]. The shop was reasonably well stocked, but the equipment it sold was usually in less than perfect condition. Therefore prices were cheaper than normal. It did not deal in [[Droid/Legends|droids]], vehicles, or [[Starship/Legends|starships]].
